learning_outcomes.text: Graduates will be able to do a design drawing documentation, apply dimensional and geometric accuracy including the appropriate surface roughness with respect to production, measurement and interchangeability in production and assembly.
Knowledge of imaging, dimensioning, dimensional and geometric accuracy, surface quality, choice of material, semi-finished products and standardized elements of machine parts.
Ability to apply the acquired knowledge within doing a drawing documentation of components made of moulded semi-finished products regarding their function and interchangeability.
Ability to read drawing documentation and understand the technological processes needed in the production of basic engineering components.

syllabus_topics: Imaging in sectional views and cross sections.
Basic rule of tolerancing and dependent tolerances.
Selected functional and technological elements of machine parts.
Geometric tolerances – choice of values, relative geometric accuracy.
Overview of normalization of metal materials.

assessment_methods.method: computer test with multiple-choice and production tasks (exam)

assessment_rules: The subject is completed by taking an exam after the credit has been previously awarded. To get credit, a student must obtain at least 50 points out of 100 from participation in exercises, graphic works (min. 20 p.), tests (min. 30 p.), and work assignments. The exam evaluates comprehensive mastery and ability to apply knowledge, consisting of a computer test, and requires at least 50 points out of 100. The resulting classification is according to the ECTS scale. Attendance at seminars is mandatory and controlled; absence from a maximum of two seminars does not need to be compensated.
institution: WYSOKÉ UCENI TECHNICKÉ V BRNE - Brno University of Technology
